2607.26780.title: Enhancing Generative Information Extraction with Two-step Validation: A Product Attribute Use Case
2607.26780.paper_summary: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to process and generate text has introduced potential for applications in information extraction (IE). While it's debated whether LLMs outperform smaller fine-tuned models for classification tasks, their strong generalization capability makes them promising for domains with limited labeled data available for fine-tuning. This advantage is particularly relevant for the emerging application of the digital product passport (DPP), where the problem space is broad but domain-specific data remains scarce. Motivated by this use case, we apply generative IE to the product domain, explicitly addressing efficiency, generalizability, and data privacy constraints. We propose a two-step validation method that integrates a PLM block into the generative IE pipeline and thereby leverages LLMs' correction capability. We discover that such a validation task enhances LLM performance, particularly on the extraction of weakly expressed, low-salience entities that appear sparsely throughout the text. For certain entities, the performance of mid-size models can even reach levels comparable to larger models, and the improvement of first-step PLM predictions also enhance the final LLM output. Nevertheless, the effects on the smallest open-source LLMs (e.g., Llama-3.2 3B) is limited. Based on the findings, we develop a demo application for product information extraction that utilizes locally deployed LLMs, targeting further adaptations to real-world DPP use cases.
2607.26780.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）處理和生成文本的能力為信息提取（IE）應用引入了潛力。雖然關於LLMs在分類任務中是否優於較小的微調模型仍存在爭議，但它們強大的泛化能力使其在可用於微調的標記數據有限的領域中顯得前景可期。這一優勢對於新興的數字產品護照（DPP）應用尤其相關，因為該問題空間廣泛但領域特定數據仍然稀缺。受到這一用例的激勵，我們將生成性IE應用於產品領域，明確解決效率、泛化性和數據隱私的限制。我們提出了一種兩步驗證方法，將PLM模塊整合到生成性IE管道中，從而利用LLMs的修正能力。我們發現這樣的驗證任務增強了LLM的性能，特別是在提取那些在文本中稀疏出現的弱表達、低重要性實體方面。對於某些實體，中型模型的性能甚至可以達到與大型模型相當的水平，第一步PLM預測的改進也增強了最終LLM的輸出。然而，對於最小的開源LLMs（例如，Llama-3.2 3B）的影響有限。根據這些發現，我們開發了一個用於產品信息提取的演示應用，利用本地部署的LLMs，旨在進一步適應現實世界的DPP用例。
